name: Mirrored Canyon of Whispering Winds
description: A narrow canyon whose walls are perfect mirrors, reflecting the sky and creating infinite corridors of light.
prompt: A deep desert canyon with walls of flawless mirror glass. The mirrors reflect a star‑filled night sky and a glowing aurora above, producing endless recursive vistas. A gentle wind stirs sand, catching light. Wide panoramic view, high contrast, 8K resolution.
caption: Walk between reflections and hear the wind whisper infinity. 🌌🪞 #MirroredCanyon
